# Trustpilot (2 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /business-search | `query` | 1 | Search Trustpilot businesses |
| /reviews | `domain` | 5 | Get Trustpilot reviews for a business |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `query`: Business name or keyword (e.g. 'nike'). Matches companies, not products; do not pass a bare domain.
- `depth` *(optional, integer)*: Number of business results to retrieve (default 20, multiples of 10, max 140). More results = longer task time.
- `domain`: The business's domain on Trustpilot (e.g. 'www.nike.com' or 'booking.com'), from business-search.
- `depth (/reviews)` *(optional, integer)*: Number of reviews to retrieve (default 20, multiples of 20, max 200). There is no pagination beyond 200.
- `sort` *(optional, enum: recency | relevance)*: Review ordering: `recency` (newest first, default) or `relevance`.

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/trustpilot/business-search?query=nike" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
